summary: Frontend-only test of VozLeads landing updates. Mobile (390) on / and /es: hamburger visible, sheet opens with all 8 section links + Acceder/Llamada demo/Empezar ahora; section links close sheet and scroll to section (top ~80px = scroll-mt-20); demo link scrolls to #solicitar; register/login links navigate correctly and don't leave body pointer-events locked. 800/1100: hamburger visible, header buttons single line (36-38px, header 65px). 1280/1920: inline nav visible, hamburger hidden. #citas (online-booking + mock + CTA -> /registro) OK. #voces 6 cards OK, demo button fetches /api/voice-preview/demo.wav (200 audio/wav) and toggles to 'Parar'. #funciones heading '20 funciones en todos los planes', 20 feature-card incl. all 6 required, 11 feature-soon-card each with 'Próximamente'. Hero checklist contains the 3 new items. No horizontal overflow at any width; no JS page errors (only expected 401s from /api/auth/me & /api/auth/refresh for anonymous visitors). /cl and /es/clinicas-dentales render with all anchors present.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid used raw accented names (agent-team-lucía, agent-team-verónica) instead of agent-team-lucia/-veronica. FIXED by testing agent via NFD normalization.

integration_issues.issue: Legal.jsx reuses <Nav/>; links are bare hashes (#citas, #voces...) so on legal pages none of the 8 section links work (no matching ids). Now more visible since the mobile menu exposes them. Use '/#citas' style hrefs (or Link to '/' + hash) when not on a landing page.

issues: Verónica card: '· Latinoamérica' wraps to a second line while other cards are single line, making card heights/alignment inconsistent. Consider placing country on its own line for all cards or shortening to 'LatAm'.
Inline nav with 8 links + 3 buttons is tight; logo nearly touches 'Plataforma'. Acceptable but consider gap-5 or showing inline nav from 1366px.
After tapping 'Citas' in menu, section top landed at ~26px (under the sticky header) instead of ~80px, likely because vl-reveal translateY animation shifts the section after scroll. Minor.

action_items: Make Nav/MobileMenu section hrefs work on non-landing pages (Legal): use '/#section' when the section id does not exist on the page.
Optional: fix Verónica card wrapping and 1280px header spacing.
critical_code_review_comments: Chrome.jsx LINKS are bare hashes shared by Legal pages -> dead links there.
Highlights.jsx: data-testid built from accented names (fixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public landing; no auth. 401s on /api/auth/me and /api/auth/refresh are expected for anonymous users. Sector page example /es/clinicas-dentales.
